title: What Scripture Actually Means When It Says a Godly Man Isn't Double-Minded
caption:
It's not about having doubts. It's about having a second self.

A double-minded man is unstable in all his ways (James 1:8). James wasn't warning about uncertainty. He was warning about the man split between two versions of himself, the church one and the group-chat one.

Check the version of you alone with your phone. That's the tell. The fix isn't performing consistency in public. It's making the private version match the public one.

Run one rule: would you do this in every room?

#faith #christianmen #manofgod #integrity #consistency
